distribution.narrative: Baseline and Wang et al. (2021) agree on Heilongjiang, Jilin and Xinjiang at province level. Wang et al. provides multiple sampled localities but does not expand the province-level synthesis.

host_note: Baseline hosts are retained; Wang et al. (2021) adds Picea jezoensis and Picea obovata and confirms Picea koraiensis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ips typographus (Linnaeus, 1758).
